title: The root README disagrees with the current CLI
body:
The root `README.md` disagrees with the current CLI in several places. A survey of `dev` on 2026-11-02 checked the first against the release binary and the rest by reading the code:

- The seeds example names queries and targets (`query1`, `target1`), but `--seeds` reads positions unless `--seeds-format names` is given; following it fails with `invalid digit found in string`.
- It says alignment output goes to stdout by default; nail writes alignments only with `--ali-out` or `-x`.
- It names the tmp directory `./tmp/`; nail uses `./tmp-nail/`.
- It writes `results.bl` for `results.tbl`.
- It says the pipeline runs `mmseqs search`; nail runs `mmseqs prefilter` and `mmseqs align`.
- Its results header example is padded, unlike the real output.

## Proposal

Correct each against the current CLI.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/87ab289b
notes.text: The padded header example ties to nail-3d2994, and the sorted rows to nail-06b3e4.
